scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-calladoc-rules --config firebase.rules-test.json "jest --config jest.rules.config.js --runInBand"
scripts.test:storage: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-calladoc-credentials --config firebase.storage-test.json "jest --config jest.storage.config.js --runInBand"
